# 4U Repair & Services LLC

> Family-run appliance repair serving Greater New Orleans, Louisiana (also listed on Google as "4U Repair & Services LLC"). Refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens, ranges, dishwashers, freezers and ice makers. Fast same/next-day service, honest upfront pricing. Named in honor of Anthony ("Ant"). Part of the TN Appliance Exchange family (technician-led, family-owned since 2012).

Owner-technician: Andre Pivacek. Phone: (504) 909-9413. Service area: New Orleans (incl. New Orleans East), the West Bank (Gretna, Marrero, Harvey, Westwego, Algiers, Terrytown), Metairie, Kenner, Chalmette, LaPlace, the Baton Rouge area, plus the North Shore (Slidell, Mandeville, Covington) and Houma. Cash jobs. Pricing: $80 diagnostic, plus the part and roughly $100-$200 labor — quoted upfront before any work.

## Services
- [Refrigerator & Freezer Repair](https://applianceman504.com/refrigerator-repair.html): A warm fridge is an emergency — hundreds of dollars of food on the line. 4U gets to New Orleans refrigerators fast and fixes the real cause, not just the symptom.
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://applianceman504.com/washer-repair.html): Top-load or front-load, HE or old-school — if your washer won't spin, won't drain, leaks, or walks across the laundry room, 4U gets it washing right again.
- [Dryer Repair](https://applianceman504.com/dryer-repair.html): No heat, taking three cycles to dry, or making a racket? 4U fixes electric and gas dryers so your clothes come out dry in one run — and your vent stays safe.
- [Oven, Range & Cooktop Repair](https://applianceman504.com/oven-repair.html): Gas or electric — when the oven won't heat, bakes uneven, throws a fault code, or a burner dies, 4U gets dinner back on the table.
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://applianceman504.com/dishwasher-repair.html): Not draining, not cleaning, or leaking onto your floor? 4U gets your dishwasher running clean and quiet without you buying a new one.
